input: Source reclaimed wood for a custom coffee table

gold.taskTitle: Source reclaimed wood for a custom coffee table
gold.taskDescription: Find and acquire suitable reclaimed wood material to build a custom coffee table.

questions.title: What are the exact dimensions of the table top?
questions.description: Understand the length, width, and thickness of wood needed.

questions.title: Which wood species do you prefer for this project?
questions.description: Identify if the user has a preference such as oak, pine, walnut, or barn wood.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the reclaimed wood?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to narrow down sourcing options.

questions.title: Are you sourcing locally or open to shipping?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to pick up the wood in person or have it delivered.

questions.title: What finish or aesthetic look are you going for?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants heavily weathered, lightly distressed, or smooth-planed reclaimed wood.

questions.title: Do you need the wood already milled and dried?
questions.description: Find out if the user needs kiln-dried or surfaced lumber versus raw reclaimed boards.

questions.title: When do you need the wood by?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or target date to prioritize sourcing speed and availability.
